name: Superfire Infused Preroll | Cherry Wowie
description:
Ignite your day with Superfire Infused Pre-Rolls. Infused with premium oil and natural terpenes that burn smooth and delicious through to the very end. Whether you’re chilling at home or hanging with friends, these pre-rolls bring the perfect mix of flavor and potency. Light up, relax, and enjoy the blaze

1.2g Pre-Roll - Premium Distillate and Natural Terpenes - 20 Strains
